_about: For each of the seven guides the Readiness Check quotes (data/lab/readiness/readiness.json, by framework id), the URLs of the included rows in data/results that record the documents the guide is quoted from, written exactly as data/results writes them, or unmapped true with a note. The note says how each URL was joined: by the same address, or by title when the guide quotes a different address, and names any of the guide's documents the Atlas does not record. scripts/lab/invariants/site.mjs checks that every URL is an included row of data/results and that every guide in readiness.json appears here once.

guides.note: Joined by title. The guide quotes the roadmap PDF, Part 1, Version 1.1; the Atlas row is the digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu library page titled A Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for the Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography. The NIS Cooperation Group's questions and answers on the roadmap have no record in the Atlas documents.
Joined by title: both rows are titled Next steps in preparing for post-quantum cryptography. The guide quotes the /whitepaper/ address; the Atlas row has the /paper/ address.
Joined by title: both are titled Quantum-Readiness: Migration to Post-Quantum Cryptography. The guide quotes the PDF; the Atlas row is the CISA resource page.
Joined by title. The guide quotes the TNO copy of the second edition; the Atlas row is the AIVD page titled The PQC Migration Handbook (revised and extended second edition).
